book.name: Akaaefeso
book.title: Lihamba lya Paulo kwa bhandu bha Kuefeso

content: Kulilunga kwa bhandu bhaanhyubhalila Kilisto
Basi, nenga mopwa kukibhopo kwakya kuntumikila Bambo, nunguanyupa ntame maha handa bhula pankemitwe na Chapanga.
Manjubha ghoha mmeghe bhandu bha kuhwama na utokomaho na mulilimbilile na kulekekehana mabhene kwa mabhene kwa upalo.
Nkakalike kuukingikiha ughumu ghwene tukilunganihwa na Nhuki ghwa Chapanga kwa kutama papamu kwa uhihimilo.
Twabhoha tulungana handa hibhungo hya mmili ghumu, kangi tubhegha na Nhuki ghwa Chapanga, habhu Chapanga kakitukema na kutubhikila udumbilo ghumu ghwa lukemo lwetu.
Kabhegha Bambo yumu na kuhyubhalila kumu na ubatiso ghumu.
Kabhegha Chapanga yumu na Tate ghwa bhoha, ywakatabhala unani mwa bhandu bhooha, kangutenda lihengo kwa bhandu bhoha na kangutama nkati yetu twabhoha.
Peni kila yumu mutwenga, kapeghwa hupo ya kinhuki ya kighweka kuhuma kwa Chapanga handa pakapalite ywombe kumpegha.
Handa malembo gha Chapanga paghatyekitwe,
Basi, payikambukwa “Kakibhyela kunane,” Fwambulo yake ndo yoki? Fwambulo yake, makachu kakihika pahi pannima.
Basi, ywombe ywakahikite pahi munnima, ndo ywakaghendite kunane, kunane kyanalumu, ili kabheghe kwohele munnima.

Ywombe ndo ywakaapeghite bhandu hupo ya kighweka, bhangi kakiatenda abheghe andumilwa, bhangi abheghe ambuye, bhangi abheghe alandamiha Nhalo ghwa Maha, bhangi abheghe ahakila na bhangi abheghe ahunda.

Kakiapegha hupo ahyo ili kuabhika kala bhandu bha Chapanga kwakya kutenda lihengo lya Kilisto na kuatenda abheghe ngilii handa paghubhegha mmili ghwa Kilisto ndo ngwemuko lya bhandu bhaanhyubhalila Kilisto,

Nnando aghwo, ghwaaghendelela mbaka twabhoha patupala kubhegha papamu mu kuhyubhalila kwa twenga na mu kummanya Mwana ghwa Chapanga. Twabhegha bhandu tuukamalite na atwihiliko handa bhula pakabheghite Kilisto mwene.
Basi, twaabhegha ng'obhe kangi handa bhana, patuyukwayukwa na kuyebhehwa kunu na kula na kutolwa na liyegha lya mahundo gha kulipulwa na bhandu ahwangi, ili abhatende bhandu bhangi ahobhe kwa lukila.
Kihyengo kyake, tulighombele hoto kwa upalo na twakukula mu milando yoha kulandana na Kilisto ywene ndo kilongohi ghwetu,

kuhuma muutabhala ghwake, mmili ghwoha ghungulungana na kumamatana papamu kwa kutangatilwa na kila kibhungo. Basi, kila kibhungo pakitenda lihengo lyake muyinoghwa, mmili ghwoha ghungukula na kulichenga mu upalo.
Ubhumi ghwa hyono mu Kilisto
Basi, kwa lihina lya Bambo, nungubhakinya, nkotoke kutama kangi handa bhandu bhammanyite ng'obhe Chapanga, bhene mahwacho ghabhe ghamema ubhughabhugha ghweka.
Bhandu abho mahala ghabhe ghabhegha mulubhindu, Abheghakutali na ubhumi ghwa Chapanga kubhukana na uhilamahala ghuubheghite nkati mwabhe na ukaidi ghwabhe.
Bhandu abho abhegha ng'obhe na honi kangi pabhatenda mihalo mihakata, na bhangughendelela kupala kutenda mihalo mihakata kwakya kuliyeleha bhene.
Peni mwenga pamulihundite mihalo ya Kilisto, mukilihunda ng'obhe kutenda milando handa ayo.
Ndo kulyaghila kukita mukiyihwa telatela malango ghaki, na pammegha afwasi bhake manguhundwa bhula uhoto muubheghite mu Yesu.
Mukihundwa nnekane na matamilo ghenu gha makachu, umundu ghwenu ghwa makachu ghuukanjaghanitwe na tama hyake hya ukuluho,
hinu, mungunoghwa kubhegha bhandu bha hyono mumyoyo yenu na mumahwacho ghenu.
Mmeghe na ubhumi ghwa hyono, hada bhula Chapanga kakiabhumba nhwanane naywo, pantenda milando yiinogheha Chapanga kyanga libhaya.
Kya habho, nneke uhwangi. Kila yumu kangunoghwa kung'ombela hoto nnyake, kiyaha kila yumu mu twenga ndo kibhungo kya mmili ghumu ghwa Kilisto.
Pannyaghabhalana, nkoteke kuyitikila kiyaghabhu kyenu kibhayambuhe ntende ulemwa, na nkotoke kutama na kiyaghabhu leghileghi tipi.
Nkotoke kunpegha Nchipila ng'ebhu ya kuahotola.
Ywakabheghite kanguyibha, kaleke kuyibha kangi, ngati kayande kutenda lihengo lya maha, kamokole kubhegha na kilibhi kya kuntangatila mundu kapukwa.
Malagho mahakata ghakotoke kuyihwanika munkati yenu, ngati nnongele milando ya maha ya kuatangatila na kubhatengelehea bhala bhaayihwa.
Nkotoke kuntenda Nhuki ghwa Chapanga kayaghabhale, mana Nhuki aywo ndo mango ya Chapanga kwa mwenga, ghuubhoneha kukita mwenga ndo bhandu bhake, mbaka mulinjubha lila Chapanga pakatulopoha.
Basi, nneke yomo kulihokonyola, kuyaghabhala, kukalala na makyobho na maligho ghakotoke kubhegha kwa mwenga, na nneke kila uhokelo.
Ntendelande gha maha na kubhonelana luhungu, kila yumu na kannekekehe nnyake, handa Chapanga pakaalekekehite mwenga kwa njila ya Kilisto.
